channel.title: Epic Fury Live — US-Iran War Tracker
channel.description: Live tracking of the US-Israel-Iran conflict. Real-time updates, verified casualties, evidence, and analysis.

item.title: Iran war live: Trump says he did not offer Tehran sanctions relief
item.description: US President Trump rejects a news report claiming his administration offered Iran sanctions relief and frozen funds.

item.title: Myanmar army air strike kills dozens in Rakhine state
item.description: Nearly half a million people are displaced in Rakhine as a result of the conflict between the military and rebel groups.

item.title: Inside Yemen's front-line city as Houthis battle for control
item.description: In rare access to Yemen's conflict zone the BBC travels to the front line with pro-government soldiers.

item.title: Twelve women have been killed in one part of South Africa since July. Here's what we know so far
item.description: South African President Cyril Ramaphosa says the murders are a "stain on our national conscience".

item.title: Iran court upholds lashes sentence for singer who performed without hijab
item.description: Parastoo Ahmadi was convicted of "offending public decency" after singing while wearing a sleeveless dress during a livestreamed concert.

item.title: Four killed in helicopter crash near Montreal
item.description: The victims of the crash have not yet been identified, Quebec provincial police told the BBC.

item.title: Iranian minister says only negotiation can end conflict after Trump rejects Hormuz deal
item.description: The foreign minister says Tehran is waiting for an official rejection of a deal, despite the US President's comments.
